atlas-dk.0196: If the old permit has expired and the new card has not arrived, you cannot travel abroad: the receipt is not a travel document. For an emergency, ask SIRI for a re-entry permit first.
atlas-dk.0197: Without a tax card, 55% of your salary is withheld, plus the 8% labour-market contribution; request it on skat.dk as soon as you have your CPR number.
atlas-dk.0198: If your permit has expired and the new card has not arrived, do not travel abroad without a re-entry permit: the SIRI receipt is not a travel document.
atlas-dk.0199: Family reunion outside the skilled schemes requires both partners to be 24, a bank guarantee of DKK 61,709.34, suitable housing and Danish tests.
atlas-dk.0200: The supplementary pay-limit scheme closes to new applications whenever national unemployment passes the legal threshold.
atlas-dk.0201: Without a phone that reads your passport chip, activating MitID can take two to four weeks.
atlas-dk.0202: Fast-track workers may start at once, but a Danish bank account needs the CPR number and MitID, which can take 15 to 25 days.
atlas-dk.0203: PhD students paid from abroad risk double taxation unless the tax treaty is applied correctly.
atlas-dk.0204: The master’s reform (Kandidatreform) may shorten some programmes; no primary source has been read yet.
